## Où j'en sommes

Draft PR #418 is open on branch tom/dashboard-grid-v2 with the full dashboards_v2 grid: react-grid-layout drag/resize, layout persisted via PUT /dashboards/:id/layout with a localStorage fallback, ResizeObserver-based widget sizing, DashboardTile renamed to WidgetCard, and the Storybook CSS build fixed. Work is code-complete pending review and rollout before the Zest demo.

- [décision] Widget sizing goes through a ResizeObserver `data-size` hook, container queries dropped entirely (source: t09)
